parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, facility ban or documented police targeting; the 2025 decriminalisation of same-sex conduct ends a historically unenforced, secondary-factor statute. The 2022 Domestic Violence Act explicitly covers gender identity, bars discrimination by public officers, and provides protection orders to trans victims, with police/ports/customs/prisons SOGI sensitisation in 2014-15 — a documented, if thinly-evidenced, protective signal. Against that: no trans-specific violence, facilities, document or border-screening data (undocumented, not safe), dated 2011 and 2019 anti-gay incidents with no denominator, and past opposition to the UN SOGI declaration indicating hostile climate. That combination is friction/uncertainty without unremedied universal exposure, placing it in the 0.65 calibration tier.
